KPlugin.Description: Auto-detect the Microsoft Surface Type Cover and switch KDE Plasma's virtual keyboard / input method accordingly. When the cover is attached, uses Fcitx 5 (so mozc/rime work on the physical keyboard) and VirtualKeyboardMode 'With Touch, Tablet, and Mouse'. When detached, uses the Plasma touch keyboard and VirtualKeyboardMode 'With Touch and Tablet'. Includes a one-time setup helper that installs the cover-aware KWin input-method switcher.
